title: Eisenhower's farewell warning about the military-industrial complex

tellings.quote: Well, it's exactly what Eisenhower described when he went out of office in ' 61 in January of ' 61 when he left and Jack Kennedy came in and he said, "Beware of the military-industrial complex.

plain: When President Dwight D. Eisenhower left office in January 1961, as John F. Kennedy came in, he gave a farewell address warning: "Beware of the military-industrial complex." A UFO researcher named Steven Greer cites that speech to Michels and says what he describes is "exactly" what Eisenhower warned about. For Greer, it shows a president saw the danger of an unaccountable power built from the military and its contractors.
